== Notes ==
* Deals [[holy damage]].
* This skill will deal damage if an enchantment is [[Renewal|renewed]], whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (in the cases of [[Critical Defenses]], [[Lyssa's Aura]], and [[Kinetic Armor]]).
* This skill is often very effective against [[Dervish]]es, since they tend to rely on casting [[Flash Enchantment]]s on themselves.
